title: Lingashtakam
author: Traditional
intro: Eight verses in praise of the Shiva linga, each ending with the refrain tat pranamami sadashiva-lingam, 'I bow to that linga of Sadashiva', followed by a closing verse. It is one of the most widely sung hymns in daily Shiva puja.
note: The eight verses use a 16-matra rhythm in four beats (the Dodhaka pattern — ◡ ◡ — ◡ ◡ — ◡ ◡ — —, where ◡◡ may replace —). The closing verse is in Anushtubh.
